EmailTemplate.name: INTL - Transcript Requests - Advisor - Resolved
EmailTemplate.subject: Transcripts and transferable credits
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
The transcript requested is enclosed.
The evaluation is for admissions purposes only. It is at the academic department's discretion to determine how many of the assessed credits may be used toward an ASU degree. The student is responsible for providing a course description to their department for ASU course equivalency. If you have questions regarding what is transferable, the academic department will need to work with articulation; they may be reached at articulation@asu.edu.
The international transfer work will show in DARS and PeopleSoft as a lump sum. Please run a new audit for the updates to appear.
If you have any further questions or requests please send them to intltransreq@asu.edu.
Thank you, International Admission Services Arizona State University
